skills.name: Algebraic expressions: evaluate and combine like terms
skills.key: Like terms have the same variable part. Add their coefficients; the variable stays the same. 3x + 2 is not 5x.
tiers: evaluate ax + b for a given x (integers)
combine two or three like terms with integer coefficients
combine with rational coefficients and constants, both signs
identify terms and coefficients; write an expression from a loadout description
skills.gen: T1: a in [-9,9], b in [-20,20], x in [-5,5]. T2: e.g. 4x - 7 + 2x. T3: 1/2 x + 3 - 3/4 x - 5. T4: 'each missile weighs m, plus 300 lb of fuel' -> 4m + 300.

errors.desc: drops a negative on a term

skills.skin: loadout weight expressions, fuel + ordnance totals, thrust expressions

skills.name: Adding and subtracting linear expressions
skills.key: To subtract an expression, add the opposite of every term inside it. -(2x - 4) is -2x + 4.
tiers: add two expressions, integer coefficients
subtract two expressions, positive terms only inside
subtract with negatives inside the second expression
rational coefficients; context (two aircraft weights compared)
skills.gen: Coefficients in [-9,9] excluding 0; constants in [-20,20]. T3 must include a negative constant in the subtrahend.

errors.desc: subtracts only the first term of the second expression

skills.skin: difference in weight between two loadouts, fuel remaining minus reserve expression

skills.name: The distributive property
skills.key: Multiply the outside number by EVERY term inside, including the sign. -3(x - 4) = -3x + 12.
tiers: positive factor, positive terms
negative factor
negative factor with subtraction inside; then combine with an outside term
rational factor (1/2, 0.5, -2/3) and equivalent-expression identification
skills.gen: T1: a in [2,9]. T2: a in [-9,-2]. T3: a(x - b) + c. T4: fractional a with terms chosen so results are clean.
skills.skin: n squadrons each with (x fighters + 4 tankers), area of a hangar bay grid

skills.name: Factoring linear expressions
skills.key: Find the greatest common factor of the terms, divide each term by it, write GCF(...). Check by distributing back.
tiers: factor out a GCF from two terms, positive
GCF with a negative constant inside
factor out a negative GCF
factor out a fraction (1/2 x + 3/2 = 1/2(x + 3))
skills.gen: Build from a factored form: g(ax + b) with g in [2,12], a in [1,9], b in [-15,15]; expand to present. T4: g = 1/2, 1/3, 1/4.

errors.desc: factors out a common factor that is not the greatest

skills.skin: group identical aircraft loads, rewrite a fuel expression per tank

skills.name: Solving equations using addition or subtraction
skills.key: Do the inverse operation to BOTH sides. Check by substituting back.
tiers: x + a = b with integers
x - a = b with negatives
rational constants (decimals and fractions)
one-step context: x + reserve = total fuel
skills.gen: a,b in [-40,40]; T3 use tenths or denominators 2..8 with clean results.

errors.desc: uses the same operation instead of the inverse
errors.distractor: b + a for x + a = b

skills.skin: fuel plus reserve equals total, altitude plus climb equals target

skills.name: Solving equations using multiplication or division
skills.key: Undo multiplication by dividing both sides by the coefficient; undo division by multiplying. A fraction coefficient: multiply by its reciprocal.
tiers: ax = b, integers, exact
negative coefficient or negative b
x/a = b and fraction coefficients
context: rate x time = distance, solve for time
skills.gen: a in [-12,12] excluding 0,1; choose x in [-15,15] and compute b. T3: a = p/q with q in [2,6].
skills.skin: burn rate x minutes = fuel, speed x time = distance to bogey

skills.name: Solving two-step equations
skills.key: Undo addition or subtraction first, then undo multiplication or division. For p(x + q) = r, divide both sides by p first (or distribute).
tiers: px + q = r, positive integers, x positive
negative coefficients or constants; unknown on either side of the equals sign
p(x + q) = r; fraction/decimal coefficients; like terms to combine first
word problem: write the equation, solve, compare to the arithmetic path
skills.gen: Choose x in [-20,20] first, p in [2,12] (T3 also 1/2..1/4 and decimals), q in [-40,40], compute r. Rotate forms: px+q=r, r=px+q, q+px=r, px-q=r, p(x+q)=r.

errors.desc: divides only the x-term by p
errors.distractor: (r - q) with p applied to x only

skills.skin: time to waypoint: 4t + 12 = 60, fuel: 3 tanks + reserve = total, cost: p missiles plus a fee

skills.name: Writing and graphing inequalities
skills.key: 'At least' means >=, 'no more than' means <=. Open circle for < and >, closed circle for <= and >=. Shade toward the solutions.
tiers: match a phrase to a symbol
graph x < a or x >= a on a number line
write the inequality from a graph, including negatives
write from a context (max payload, minimum altitude)
skills.gen: a in [-15,15]; rotate the four symbols and the four phrase families (at least, at most, more than, fewer than).

errors.desc: thinks the inequality has a single answer

skills.skin: minimum safe altitude, maximum takeoff weight, ceiling limits

skills.name: Solving inequalities using addition or subtraction
skills.key: Add or subtract on both sides just like an equation. The symbol does not flip for adding or subtracting.
tiers: x + a < b, positive integers
negatives on either side
rational constants
context, then graph the solution
skills.gen: a,b in [-30,30]; T3 tenths or simple fractions.

errors.desc: shades the wrong direction for 5 < x

skills.skin: fuel above reserve, altitude margin above terrain

skills.name: Solving inequalities using multiplication or division
skills.key: Divide or multiply both sides. If you divide or multiply by a NEGATIVE, reverse the inequality symbol.
tiers: ax > b with a positive
a negative: flip required
x/a with a negative; fraction coefficients
context with a negative rate (descent) and a limit
skills.gen: a in [-12,12] excluding 0; choose boundary x in [-20,20]. Half of T2-T4 items must require a flip.

errors.desc: does not reverse when dividing by a negative

skills.skin: descent rate limits: -500t > -6000 (how long before minimum altitude)

skills.name: Solving two-step inequalities
skills.key: Undo addition/subtraction, then multiplication/division, reversing the symbol only when multiplying or dividing by a negative. Graph and interpret.
tiers: px + q < r, all positive
negative p (flip) or negative constants
p(x + q) >= r; rational coefficients
context: max ordnance weight 2w + 300 <= 1100; interpret whole-number answers
skills.gen: As ee.4.3 with symbols rotated; T2+ include flips in half the items. T4 answers must be interpreted (round down for counts).
skills.skin: max payload, minimum fuel for a leg count, credits budget for n upgrades
